findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code injection and unsafe deserialization in aiohttp
 * @description Checking for eval/exec usage and unsafe deserialization patterns
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // Code execution functions
    call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec", "compile"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
    
    // Unsafe deserialization
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall() or
    
    // Code execution via other modules
    call = API::moduleImport("code").getMember(["compile_command", "interact"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("imp").getMember(["load_module", "load_source"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("importlib").getMember(["import_module", "reload"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially dangerous code execution or deserialization operation that could lead to arbitrary code execution."
findings.hypothesis: Code injection via eval/exec or unsafe deserialization patterns in aiohttp

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Detailed code execution analysis
 * @description Find all eval, exec, pickle.load, yaml.load calls with context
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/detailed-code-execution
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // eval and exec
    call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall() or
    
    // pickle
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    
    // yaml
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    
    // marshal
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    
    // shelve
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe code execution or deserialization operation: " + call.toString()
findings.hypothesis: Detailed analysis of code execution and deserialization operations found earlier

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure random number generation
 * @description Using weak random number generators for security purposes
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/insecure-random
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-338
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // Check for random module usage
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("random").getMember(["random", "randint", "randrange", "choice", "shuffle"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("secrets").getMember(["choice", "randbelow"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially insecure random number generation for security-sensitive operations"
findings.hypothesis: Insecure random number generation for security purposes
